sentences.text: But, the wonderful thing about failure is that it's entirely up to us to decide how to look at it.
P2 We can choose to see failure as "the end of the world".
Or, we can look at failure as the incredible learning experience that it often is.
Every time we fail at something, we can choose to look for the lesson we're meant to learn.
These lessons are very important; they're how we grow, and how we keep from making that same mistake again.
Failures stop us only if we let them.
P3 Failure can also teach us things about ourselves that we would never have learned otherwise.
For instance, failure can help you discover how strong a person you are.

P1 Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can
identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid. To find out if this extends to non-living beings,
Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect
social signals from robotic rats.

这是否延伸到非生命体,加州大学圣地亚哥分校的Laleh Quinn和她的同事们测试了老鼠是否能够检测到来
自机器老鼠的社交信号。
P2 They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat—one social and one asocial—for four
days. The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with

非社交型机器只是简单地前后和左右移动。

them by pressing a lever. Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 percent more likely on average
to set the social robot free than the asocial one. This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as

P1 It's almost impossible to go through life without experiencing some kind of failure. But, the
wonderful thing about failure is that it's entirely up to us to decide how to look at it.
P2 We can choose to see failure as "the end of the world". Or, we can look at failure as the
incredible learning experience that it often is. Every time we fail at something, we can choose to look
for the lesson we're meant to learn. These lessons are very important; they're how we grow, and how we
keep from making that same mistake again. Failures stop us only if we let them.
P3 Failure can also teach us things about ourselves that we would never have learned otherwise.
For instance, failure can help you discover how strong a person you are. Failing at something can help
you discover your truest friends, or help you find unexpected motivation to succeed.

help sb (to) do 是「帮助某人做某事」，这里 help you discover 译「帮你发现 / 让你认识

强的人

且语序已被「打乱」需还原
这是 how strong a person you are 的特殊语序：how strong 把形容词提前了，正常理解是

是个多么坚强的人 / 你有多坚强」。注意它是陈述语气的宾语从句，不是真在发问。

motivation to succeed.
【意群】Failing at something can help you discover your truest friends,（主干分句一（动名词主语 + help
sb do））★采分→在某事上失败能帮你发现你最真的朋友
难点：Failing at something 是动名词作主语「（在某事上）失败这件事」；truest friends
= 最真心 / 最可靠的朋友
Failing at something 是动名词短语作主语，指「（经历）失败」。truest 是 true 的最高级，
friends 前的 truest friends 不是「最真实的朋友」，而是「最真心、最靠得住的朋友」（患难
见真情之意）。help you discover 同上句「帮你发现」。
or help you find unexpected motivation to succeed.（并列谓语分句二（or + help sb do））★采
分→或帮你找到意想不到的成功的动力
难点：or 并列第二个 help…；unexpected motivation to succeed = 意想不到的、促使你
成功的动力；to succeed 作 motivation 的定语
or 连接第二个 help you do，与前一个 help 并列，主语仍是 Failing at something。
motivation to succeed 中的 to succeed 是不定式作定语，修饰 motivation，意为「（去）成
功的动力」；unexpected＝「意想不到的、出乎意料的」。整块即「帮你找到意想不到的、激
励你走向成功的动力」。
【调序】to succeed 不定式定语前移；or 并列项补出共同主语

串起来，使整句主语连贯。
【译文】在某件事上失败，能帮你看清谁才是最真心的朋友，也能帮你找到意想不到的成功
